description: Defines data schemas using Pydantic BaseModel for chat messages, sessions, requests, and responses in a medical support chatbot system. Contains class models and a disclaimer string.

classes.name: Message
classes.description: Represents an individual message in the chat with role, content, and timestamp.

classes.name: ChatSession
classes.description: Represents a chat session with unique ID, optional title, timestamps, and list of messages.

classes.name: ChatRequest
classes.description: Represents a user's request containing optional session ID and message content.

classes.name: ChatResponse
classes.description: Represents the chatbot's reply, including session ID, updated messages, and recommendations.

classes.name: SessionSummary
classes.description: Summarizes a chat session with ID, optional title, and timestamps.
